termsAndConditionsStep.TermsContent:
AliasVault is designed to enhance your online security and protect your privacy. With AliasVault, you can create unique identities and email aliases for your various online accounts, helping you maintain control over your personal information and reduce the risk of identity theft.

By using AliasVault, you agree to the following terms:

1. You will not use AliasVault for any illegal purposes, including but not limited to fraud, identity theft, or impersonating real individuals.

2. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and any aliases created through AliasVault.

3. AliasVault reserves the right to terminate your account if we suspect any misuse or violation of these terms.

4. You understand that while AliasVault enhances your privacy, no system is completely foolproof, and you use the service at your own risk.

importServices.BitwardenDescription: Import passwords from your Bitwarden vault
importServices.BitwardenInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Bitwarden vault, you need to export it. You can do this by logging into your Bitwarden account, going to the 'Tools' menu and selecting 'Export vault'.

importServices.ChromeDescription: Import passwords from your Chrome Password Manager
importServices.ChromeInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Chrome Password Manager, you need to export it as a CSV file. You can do this by logging into your Chrome browser, going to the 'Settings' menu > 'Password and AutoFill' > 'Google Password Manager'. Then click on 'Export passwords'.
importServices.ChromeInstructionsPart2: Once you have exported the file, you can upload it below.
importServices.DashlaneDescription: Import passwords from your Dashlane account
importServices.DashlaneInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Dashlane passwords, you need to export it as a CSV file. You can do this by logging into your Dashlane account, going to the 'Account' > 'Settings' menu and selecting 'Export to CSV'.
importServices.DashlaneInstructionsPart2: Note: the .zip file you download will contain a "credentials.csv" file. You need to unzip the archive first, and then upload the "credentials.csv" CSV file below.
importServices.DropboxInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Dropbox Passwords, you need to export them as a CSV file. You can do this by opening Dropbox Passwords, going to 'Account' > 'Export' (to .CSV).
importServices.EdgeDescription: Import passwords from your Microsoft Edge Password Manager
importServices.EdgeInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Microsoft Edge passwords, you need to export them as a CSV file. You can do this by going to Menu > Settings > Password and autofill > Microsoft Password Manager > ... > Export passwords.
importServices.EdgeInstructionsPart2: Once you have exported the file, you can upload it below.
importServices.EnpassInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Enpass passwords, you need to export them as a CSV file. You can do this by opening Enpass, going to 'Menu' > 'File' > 'Export' and selecting 'CSV file (.csv)'.
importServices.EnpassInstructionsPart2: Once you have exported the file, you can upload it below.
importServices.FirefoxDescription: Import passwords from your Firefox Password Manager
importServices.FirefoxInstructionsPart1: In order to import your Firefox passwords, you need to export it as a CSV file. You can do this by opening your Firefox browser, going to menu > 'Passwords'. Then click on the menu icon in the top right corner and select 'Export passwords'.
importServices.FirefoxInstructionsPart2: Once you have exported the file, you can upload it below.
importServices.GenericCsvDescription: Import credentials using a template CSV format

storageInsights.BreakdownDescription: Approximate share of vault size by category. Attachments and logos usually take up most of the space.
storageInsights.DeleteAllLogosConfirmMessage: This removes every stored logo from your vault and clears the logo on each credential. You can re-download them at any time. Continue?
storageInsights.EstimatedTotalDescription: This is an approximation calculated from your local data.
storageInsights.LogoManagementDescription: Logos are fetched from the favicon of each item's website. You can delete every logo to reclaim space, or re-download them to pick up improved versions.
storageInsights.PageDescription: See an estimate of your vault size. For best sync performance, it's advised to keep your vault size small and delete items you no longer need.
storageInsights.RedownloadAllLogosConfirmMessage: This re-fetches the favicon for every credential that has a website URL, replacing the existing logo. Depending on your vault size this may take a while. Continue?
storageInsights.TopAttachmentsDescription: Top 10 largest file attachments. Remove the attachment if you no longer need it.
storageInsights.TopLogosDescription: Top 10 largest service logos. Logos are reused for items with the same domain.

welcome.ExtensionsAppsTipContent: Install the AliasVault browser extension and mobile app to create aliases and autofill forms directly from your browser and smartphone.
welcome.HowItWorksIntro: When you need to sign up for a new service:
welcome.HowItWorksStep1: AliasVault generates a random identity with a secure private email address
welcome.HowItWorksStep2: Use this information to sign up for the service
welcome.HowItWorksStep3: Received emails show up in this app and can be opened in your browser
welcome.HowItWorksStep4: Your real email address and other personal information stay private
welcome.MasterPasswordTipContent: Your master password is required to decrypt your vault. Never share it with anyone and store it in a secure location. Warning: If you lose your master password, your data cannot be recovered - not even by our team.
welcome.ReadyToStartMessage: Now that you know how AliasVault works, let's create your first secure identity!
welcome.TwoFactorTipContent: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. It requires you to enter a code from your authenticator app or provide a recovery code before your encrypted vault can be accessed.
welcome.TwoFactorTipTitle: Enable Two-Factor Authentication In Security Settings
welcome.WelcomeMessage: Your vault has been successfully created! Protect your online privacy by creating unique aliases for each service you sign up for. Let's learn how AliasVault works and then create your first secure alias.
